goal: Prepare and verify a compact first-scene RGB-D geometry dataset and metric camera poses before generating normal priors or training DN-Splatter.

source.wsl_condition: Use only after confirming actual local access and source identity; do not infer a mount or an AutoDL path.
source.format_from_audit: ROS1 bag v2.0 / Orbbec Gemini 335 SDK extended messages

segment.basis: Exact device/header timestamps from audit samples #01 and #04; relative to the first depth frame.

sampling.target_definition: start_ns + k * 200000000, integer k >= 0, target <= end_ns
sampling.selection: Nearest actual RGB timestamp within the inclusive source interval, earlier frame wins a tie; use each source RGB at most once.
sampling.depth_association: Use audited device/header nearest-depth association, enforce injective use of actual depth frames and an absolute offset <= 10 ms.
sampling.quality_screening: Inspect actual selected frames for decode failures, severe blur, occlusion/dynamic foreground and overlap. Record measured distributions, rejection reasons and retained count; no universal blur threshold is prefilled.

local.host: Windows machine with the original file, or an already available readable WSL
reuse: existing isolated bag-audit Python environment where compatible
audited Gemini-specific parser and indexed chunk reader
local.source_identity_check: Check resolved path, bytes and mtime against the audit fingerprint. Recompute source SHA-256 when identity differs or the fingerprint cannot be trusted; never claim a changed source is the audited one.
native_packet_contents: selected native uint16 depth arrays as lossless NPZ, retaining raw invalid codes
selection and injective association manifest with exact timestamps
source identity, script versions and per-file SHA-256 manifest
local.local_resource_policy: Recheck local RAM, disk and CPU; use bounded streaming/selected-payload processing. AutoDL's resource allocation is not a local resource measurement.
local.git_publication: Only compact reports, bounded previews and reusable code; neither this native data packet nor derived full datasets belong in ordinary Git.

transfer.destination: Existing DN-Splatter project on the user's AutoDL instance, in its isolated .local directory.
transfer.contents: Only the compact selected-scene packet, not the 6 GB original recording.
transfer.if_connection_unavailable: Finish the local packet and report blocked_transfer with its exact ready directory, byte count, packet-manifest SHA-256 and missing connection fact; do not fabricate a transfer or request the original bag upload.

server.cpu_gpu_policy: May use all actually allocated AutoDL CPU/GPU resources for the necessary stage, without stopping or modifying existing jobs; record measured capacity and avoid nested oversubscription.
server.github_transport: Prefer AutoDL official academic acceleration in the project command subshell for GitHub operations actually run on AutoDL.
server.install_policy: Inspect existing tool versions and CLI/API support, isolate only missing preprocessing dependencies, and record exact versions/commands. Do not reinstall the working DN environment or global CUDA stack.

registration.extrinsic_source: Audit calibration.json static_extrinsics depth -> color; verify direction, row-major layout and unit against recorded SDK metadata.

rgb_distortion.policy: Apply the recorded rational Brown-Conrady model or a correctly matched SDK Align implementation; do not assume an enum-4 projection helper handles K6.

virtual_grids.purpose: Use a documented undistorted RGB optical frame for both resolutions. The 640 grid is an initial geometry-processing choice, not a measured optimal DN training resolution.
virtual_grids.intrinsics: Save exact K for each grid, rectification/remap and any crop/resize mapping; projection and actual resampling must use the same convention.
virtual_grids.pixel_centres: SDK/OpenCV image-array coordinates use integer pixel centres; export principal point +0.5 exactly once for COLMAP/Nerfstudio's corner-based coordinates. Do not shift 3D poses when changing pixel-coordinate convention.

derived_depth.quantity: Z_C after transforming into the RGB optical coordinate system
derived_depth.overlap_resolution: z-buffer nearest positive Z_C at each target pixel
derived_depth.avoid_automatic_datamanager_undistortion: Export already-corrected RGB and matching depth with zero distortion metadata; historical GDataset uses sensor_depth, which is not jointly rectified by the parent datamanager.

distance_diagnostics.policy: Report valid-code and usable-near-surface fractions separately, depth distributions and boundary stability. Choose a supervision/scale-estimation range from actual evidence; preserve far values in native data and never silently call all non-sentinel depths accurate.

splits_and_poses.split_rule: Sort retained initial 5 Hz candidates by actual RGB time; assign a separate zero-based retained_order_index. retained_order_index % 10: 0..7 train, 8 val, 9 test.
splits_and_poses.evaluation_scope: Held-out views within this capture, not an independently captured scene/trajectory and not an external geometric ground truth.
splits_and_poses.primary_method: COLMAP calibrated RGB SfM, one shared fixed intrinsic camera per actual grid, with explicitly disabled focal/principal-point/distortion refinement.
splits_and_poses.metric_scale_inputs: Training-camera observations of training-map points and valid registered training depth only.
splits_and_poses.metric_scale_policy: Estimate one robust global positive scale for the connected model; save sample/track selection, rejection rules, residual distributions and per-time/depth stability. Apply the same scale to camera translations and map points. Do not fit a separate scale per frame or use held-out depth.
splits_and_poses.heldout_pose_policy: Localize each held-out RGB against the fixed training map with PnP/pose refinement only. Do not optimize the map or shared intrinsics with held-out observations; do not use held-out depth in localization or scale fitting.
splits_and_poses.missing_heldout_poses: Report all failures and denominators; never silently drop failed held-out views or substitute identity poses.
splits_and_poses.all_rgb_sfm_alternative: If separately attempted, label it all_rgb_sfm_diagnostic and disclose that held-out RGB influenced pose/map estimation. Keep its outputs/metrics separate; it is not the strict training-map protocol.
continuity_failure_escalation: Inspect registration failures, graph components, actual overlap, blur and candidate-gap locations.
Request extra source frames only around actual gaps, first at 10 Hz and then native rate if justified. Record new bridge frames as training-map support and keep initial val/test IDs frozen.
If geometry still fails, use one explicitly recorded Open3D RGB-D odometry/pose-graph alternative on the verified common grid; retain its own evaluation-input disclosure and compare residuals.
splits_and_poses.imu_policy: Retain the existence/provenance of IMU; do not treat zero orientation quaternions as camera poses and do not require a new VIO calibration project for this stage.

engineering_targets.scope: Target for pipeline coverage, not a camera-pose accuracy guarantee or a universal paper threshold.

required_pose_evidence: all attempted/registered/unregistered train and held-out image IDs
connected components and retained time coverage
track lengths, triangulation/baseline evidence and reprojection-error distributions
relative trajectory, discontinuities and localized held-out failures
metric scale fit residuals and temporal/distance stability
occlusion-aware cross-view depth/point-cloud consistency with the exact masks and sample counts
same-view and cross-view overlays of actual nearby surfaces

completion.output: Geometry report and, only when evidence supports it, a prepared dataset with real camera poses and matching RGB-grid depth.
completion.on_failed_geometry: Keep the diagnostic report, actual failures and partial packet/model; do not mark a trainable dataset complete.

subsequent_dn_requirements.pose: Per-frame metric RGB-camera c2w, convert OpenCV c2w by right-multiplying diag(1,-1,-1,1) for OpenGL; invert COLMAP w2c first.
subsequent_dn_requirements.depth: Matching-grid Z_C float32 metres .npy, zero invalid, depth_unit_scale_factor=1.0.
subsequent_dn_requirements.point_initialization: Construct from allowed training RGB-D frames only; supply a real ply_file_path before the default load_pcd_normals path is enabled.
subsequent_dn_requirements.normals: Generate Omnidata later from the final processed training-grid RGB, save same-stem PNGs in normals_from_pretrain, use the verified opengl convention and check exact per-frame correspondence.
subsequent_dn_requirements.depth_validity: Historical DN only tests depth > depth_tolerance; invalid 65535 and rejected/unknown depths must already be zero.
subsequent_dn_requirements.no_gt_geometry_accuracy_claim: No Faro/F-score/absolute mesh accuracy without independent geometric ground truth.

report_requirements: source audit commit and full bag SHA-256
actual selected, decoded, exported and transferred counts
packet manifest SHA-256 and verified recipient status
exact tool versions, code versions and executed commands
actual grid intrinsics, distortion/coordinate transformations and depth coverage
primary versus alternative reconstruction protocol identity
all pose and scale failures plus evidence-based next action
prepared dataset location, file sizes and hashes, or the precise blocking stage
